messages:
acme_billing: hey @maria_support our CSV export for project acme-prod has duplicate rows around Mar 3-4. Dashboard shows 12,345 tokens but the CSV sum is ~24,690 — we're being billed off the CSV. Can you look?

maria_support: thanks — can you paste a tiny sample of the duplicate rows and the export path? I'll escalate to billing & ingest.

acme_billing: sample rows from raw export:
```
project,day,tokens,request_id
acme-prod,2026-03-03,12345,
acme-prod,2026-03-03,12345,
acme-prod,2026-03-04,0,req-9988
```
also pulled from /exports/raw/2026-03-03-acme-prod.csv

maria_support: pinging @sam_ingest and @lee_sre — this looks like a duplicate ingestion window.

sam_ingest: thanks. quick checklist: which export type did you pull? raw-usage-export (streamed rows) or daily-rollup?

acme_billing: raw-usage-export (raw rows). we downloaded directly from the S3-export link sent by the UI.

devon_billing: fyi the billing UI applies a dedupe/rollup, so dashboard vs invoice delta can happen if raw rows contain duplicates. However raw should not contain exact duplicate rows for the same token bucket.

maria_support: can you provide the file size + sha256 of the file you downloaded? and the invoice id so billing can flag it?

acme_billing: sha256: abc123def4567890
size: 1.2MB
invoice: INV-2026-03-07-ACME

sam_ingest: looking at ingestion logs for acme-prod on 2026-03-03 — we had a shard replay on node-7 during 03:05-03:15 UTC due to a transient Kafka commit failure. That replay retried messages and some records lacked request_id, so our dedupe key (project+request_id) missed them. Result: duplicate raw rows.

lee_sre: root cause narrowed: commit glitch triggered a partial replay without sequence metadata for older connector version. We're deploying a fix to include sequence_id fallback in dedupe keys and a hard dedupe pass during backfills. ETA for deployment 4h.

sam_ingest: plan: 1) run a targeted dedupe backfill for acme-prod for 2026-03-03 03:00-03:30 UTC, job id bf-20260304-001; 2) generate corrected raw export and new download link; 3) send corrected token totals to billing for invoice adjustment. Kicking off backfill now. Monitor: /internal/jobs/bf-20260304-001/logs

devon_billing: thanks. provisional numbers: original CSV total (as you reported) ~24,690 tokens, dashboard canonical total 12,345. If backfill fixes duplicates, expected corrected CSV total 12,345 — delta -12,345 tokens. We'll prepare a provisional credit estimate (holding invoice under review) and attach to INV-2026-03-07-ACME. No dispute form required immediately; we'll mark as 'under review'.

maria_support: @acme_billing we'll update this thread when the backfill completes and when billing posts the adjustment. 

sam_ingest: backfill started, job bf-20260304-001. expected finish ~45m. Will post corrected export link and checksum once done. :thumbsup:

acme_billing: appreciated. please ping ASAP — finance team needs confirmation today.

maria_support: will do — keeping this on high priority.
